build_crf_transition_graph: build a bigram transition graph for a linear-chain CRF with a given number of classes
build_crf_potential_graph: build a unary potential graph for a linear-chain CRF with given features and classes
run_linear_crf_training: run SGD training for a linear-chain CRF model using the GTN library
sample_crf_model: sample sequences from a linear-chain CRF model using potentials and transitions graphs
compute_crf_loss: compute the CRF loss for a given input-output pair using potentials and transitions
